## What's Changed
* Added support for Python 3.15.
* Dropped support for EoL Python 3.8, 3.9.
* Fixed exponential merge key expansion (#937).
* Exposed libyaml 0.2.6 recursion control API (#1010) - no-op when missing.
* Bumped wheel builds to libyaml 0.2.6.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/compare/6.0.3...6.0.4

## What's Changed

* Support for Python 3.14 and free-threading (experimental).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/compare/6.0.2...6.0.3

## What's Changed
* Support for Cython 3.x and Python 3.13.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/compare/6.0.1...6.0.2

* Support for extension build with Cython 3.x
* Support for Python 3.13
* Added PyPI wheels for musllinux on aarch64
releases.name: 6.0.2rc1
